name: MFI(18) smoothed turn-up with SMA200 stop
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: MFI = SMA(MFI(close,18),18). Buy when smoothed MFI rises two bars in a row (mfi[2]<mfi[1]<mfi) while close > SMA(200).
exit: Close long when smoothed MFI falls for one bar (mfi[1]>mfi) pattern; stop at SMA(200).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
implementation_notes: mfidn definition is (mfi[1] > mfi) and (mfi[2] < mfi[1]) which is only true at a peak; implement literally.
